source_snapshot.procedure: Create data with `dd of=/nvme14n1`, contains duplicated malformed `/zero` text, then run gdsio on `/nvme11n1/dd1G` across CPU.
source_snapshot.criteria: GDS executes without issue and bandwidth is better than non-GDS.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies GDS/cuFile/gdsio and sustained-I/O risk but no safe target or matched comparator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Reject ambiguous writes; require scratch identity, topology, matched comparator, numeric oracle, integrity and recovery.

old_problem: The source mixed malformed and inconsistent absolute paths, could create or overwrite data on an unknown filesystem, omitted the required non-GDS comparator, and supplied no topology, cache, numeric improvement or integrity contract; executing it could damage data and yield an invalid comparison.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents gdsio as the GDS benchmarking utility and requires interpreting results through the storage/GPU/PCIe topology. ED-04 forbids unknown storage targets, while ED-03 and ED-15 allow the scratch identity, matched trial profile and signed improvement threshold to be bound as project configuration. The malformed raw examples are explicitly prohibited, not guessed.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row379 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2972 and unique variant.

Verified NVIDIA's current GDS Benchmarking and Configuration Guide: GDS uses a direct storage-to-GPU path, gdsio reports throughput/latency/IOPS, and PCIe/root-complex/CPU locality and page-cache behavior materially affect results.
Preserved cross-CPU GDS coverage, source 1 GiB size, 1 MiB I/O, GPU device index intent, write mode, 60-second phase and required better-than-non-GDS comparison, subject to safe identity binding.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row380 and verified its manifest identity; no file creation, storage write, gdsio or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Identity-bound paired GPUDirect Storage versus non-GDS benchmark
test_case.purpose: Validate the approved storage-to-GPU cross-CPU GDS path and prove, with matched trials and data-integrity evidence, that its signed performance improvement over non-GDS is achieved without harming storage, GPU or platform health.
required_package: Pinned compatible NVIDIA driver, CUDA, GDS/cuFile, gdsio and reviewed wrapper hashes
NVMe serial/namespace, filesystem UUID/mount, disposable scratch-directory allowlist, capacity and backup/data-owner approval
GPU UUID/BDF mapped from the source device-index intent plus CPU/NUMA/PCIe/root-complex/storage topology
Matched GDS and non-GDS direction, 1 GiB file size, 1 MiB I/O, write/read mode, 60-second duration, repetitions, ordering and cache/O_DIRECT policy
Signed bandwidth/latency/IOPS statistic, minimum GDS improvement/tolerance and data-integrity oracle
SMART/endurance, GPU/PCIe/thermal/power aborts, cleanup and recovery
test_case.test_command: Never execute the source `/nvme14n1`, `/zero` or unverified `/nvme11n1/dd1G` steps. After twice verifying the approved non-OS, non-mounted-sensitive scratch filesystem and topology, create/checksum only the allowlisted disposable scratch file, run order-balanced parameter-matched gdsio GDS and non-GDS trials for the approved profile, preserve complete raw metrics and health data, recheck integrity, then perform only approved cleanup.
test_case.expected_result: Both matched paths complete without error on the same identity-bound scratch data; all checksums remain correct; the approved GDS statistic exceeds the matched non-GDS statistic by the signed margin/tolerance; no storage, PCIe, GPU, thermal, power or data-health anomaly occurs; cleanup and final state match approval.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires safe target identity, complete paired raw samples under identical controlled parameters, signed improvement and integrity thresholds, and clean health/recovery evidence. GDS execution alone, one unmatched number, cache-contaminated results or any write to an unverified path cannot pass.
safety_gate: Exclude OS/boot/EFI/swap/LVM/RAID/device-mapper/mounted-sensitive/unknown targets; require serial+namespace+filesystem UUID double-check and explicit data-owner approval
Use only an allowlisted disposable scratch file with capacity, backup and cleanup plan; raw device writes are forbidden
Pin GPU UUID and full CPU/NUMA/PCIe/storage path; monitor SMART/endurance, filesystem, GPU/XID, AER, thermal and power
Abort on identity drift, capacity/integrity error, device reset, media/AER/XID/thermal/power anomaly; preserve evidence and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Stack and wrapper hashes plus NVIDIA GDS compatibility state
NVMe serial/namespace/filesystem UUID/mount/scratch identity, exclusions, capacity, backup and approval
Exact matched GDS/non-GDS commands/profile/order/cache policy and complete throughput/latency/IOPS samples
Checksum/integrity results and pre/post SMART/filesystem/GPU/PCIe/thermal/power evidence
Signed comparison calculation, approved cleanup/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any wrong-target indication, integrity mismatch or health event, stop I/O without cleanup or retry, preserve the scratch file and all first-fault evidence, unmount/isolate only under the approved storage runbook, restore from verified backup if authorized, quarantine the device/path and recover GPU/services separately before further testing.

source_conflict.reason: The malformed and inconsistent source paths are explicitly rejected; the Review layer preserves the intended 1 GiB/1 MiB/60-second GDS coverage using one approved scratch identity and adds the missing matched non-GDS comparator and signed oracle.

blocked.reason: Official gdsio semantics and a safe paired method are established; exact target, topology and thresholds are execution prerequisites rather than unresolved command meaning.
